reviewed_examples.state: Which mayor did more vetoing than anticipated?
reviewed_examples.question: Which passage answers the query? Pay attention to negation.
gold: In his first year as mayor, Medill received very little legislative resistance from the Chicago City Council. While he vetoed what was an unprecedented eleven City Council ordinances that year, most narrowly were involved with specific financial practices considered wasteful and none of the vetoes were overridden. He used his new powers to appoint the members of the newly constituted Chicago Board of Education and the commissioners of its constituted public library. His appointments were approved unanimously by the City Council.
reviewed_examples.finding: Unprecedented number of vetoes matches the first query; gold passage retained after permutation.

reviewed_examples.state: Which mayor did less vetoing than anticipated?
reviewed_examples.question: Which passage answers the query? Pay attention to negation.
gold: In his first year as mayor, Medill received very little legislative resistance from the Chicago City Council. While some expected an unprecedented number of vetoes, in actuality he only vetoed eleven City Council ordinances that year, and most of those were narrowly involved with specific financial practices he considered wasteful and none of the vetoes were overridden. He used his new powers to appoint the members of the newly constituted Chicago Board of Education and the commissioners of its constituted public library. His appointments were approved unanimously by the City Council.
reviewed_examples.finding: Explicitly fewer vetoes than expected matches the contrasting query and second passage.
